parameters.name: deploy_meeting_bot
parameters.description: Deploy a transcription bot to a Google Meet, Teams, or Zoom meeting. The bot joins and transcribes the conversation. IMPORTANT for Microsoft Teams: the bot cannot join without the passcode, so pass the FULL invitation link (it ends in "?p=...") or supply the passcode parameter separately. Parameters: meeting_url (required), passcode (Teams/Zoom, if not already in the URL), language (optional ISO code such as en or de, auto-detected when omitted), bot_name (optional display name), recording (optional true/false). Returns a Vexa run ID; remember it and pass it to get_transcript as vexa_run_id, otherwise a recurring meeting can return the wrong session.

parameters.name: get_transcript
parameters.description: Get the transcript of a meeting, grouped into speaker blocks with timestamps. CRITICAL: a recurring Teams or Zoom meeting reuses the same meeting ID for every session, and Vexa only ever serves the MOST RECENT run for a meeting ID. Always pass vexa_run_id, which deploy_meeting_bot returned when the bot was sent in; the tool then refuses rather than hand back a different session. Without it you may silently receive another meeting. Parameters: platform (google_meet/teams/zoom) and meeting_id, OR meeting_url; vexa_run_id (strongly recommended); from_time and to_time (HH:MM) to read part of a long meeting.

value.from_time: ={{ $fromAI('from_time', 'Only return the transcript from this wall clock time onwards, format HH:MM. Optional.', 'string') }}
value.to_time: ={{ $fromAI('to_time', 'Only return the transcript up to this wall clock time, format HH:MM. Optional.', 'string') }}
value.vexa_run_id: ={{ $fromAI('vexa_run_id', 'Vexa run ID returned by deploy_meeting_bot for this exact session. Pass it whenever you know it.', 'string') }}
